content.short: Spectra is a permissionless protocol for interest rate derivatives and fixed yields.
content.description: Spectra splits yield-bearing assets into principal and yield components so that rates can be traded separately, letting users lock a fixed return or take a view on where variable yields go. It is permissionless, meaning any yield-bearing token can have a market created for it without governance approval, and runs on Hyperliquid and Monad.
content.meta: Splits yield-bearing assets into principal and yield so rates can be traded separately.
